description: Shared enforcement vectors for Plugin Capability Manifest v1. Register every manifest in order into a policy for stage_envelope_schema_version, then authorize the hook registration, then the input envelope (if not null), then the output envelope derived from that input (if not null). expect is 'allow' or the first PluginManifestError or PluginCapabilityDenied code. Envelopes list only the fields the policy reads; artifact_ids stand for artifact references that are equal when their ids are equal.
